{
  "project_id": "P-PAK-ResilientAccessibleMicrofinance",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Recurring extreme flood events could overwhelm microfinance providers' capital buffers and lead to widespread borrower default across vulnerable agricultural and rural communities.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Establish and capitalize the Climate Risk Fund (CRF) to provide post-disaster contingent liquidity and transfer extreme risk through an international parametric reinsurance backstop.",
      "evidence": "a 1-in-a-20-year flood, as an example, would impact 705,000 borrowers and US$189 million in lending."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Macroeconomic instability and persistent inflation in Pakistan could impair borrower repayment capacity, degrading microfinance provider asset quality and curtailing overall lending.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Provide tailored liquidity facilities (IAL and CLF) on market-based terms while monitoring MFP capital adequacy and macroeconomic stress indicators.",
      "evidence": "The impact of these shocks was exacerbated by the macroeconomic crisis brewing since late 2019."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Climatic shocks can trigger a surge in non-performing loans (NPLs), leading to rapid capital adequacy erosion and liquidity impairment for Microfinance Banks (MFBs).",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Deploy Contingent Liquidity Facility (CLF) funds after qualifying flood events to enable MFPs to restructure loans and issue fresh recovery loans.",
      "evidence": "NPLs of MFBs in flood impacted areas surged by 25.7 percent... resulted in the rapid erosion of liquidity and capital of the MFBs."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Structural disintermediation away from agricultural sector lending by MFPs increases financial exclusion for small farmers and pushes them toward exploitative informal debt sources.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Implement the Pre-Climate Event Innovative Agricultural Liquidity (IAL) product to bundle agricultural loans with precision advisory support from agritech companies.",
      "evidence": "have led to a structural shift in the sector, which is gradually pivoting away from agriculture."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Rapid expansion of short-term urban nano loans for consumption smoothing risks shifting microfinance away from productive investment and over-indebting vulnerable borrowers.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Incentivize MFPs through CRF liquidity allocations to expand productive lending in climate-smart agriculture and microenterprises.",
      "evidence": "Nano loans have grown by 342 percent... alarming pivot away from lending for productive purposes to consumption smoothing."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Structural gender disparities, loan officer biases, and post-disaster mobility constraints could prevent female borrowers from accessing emergency disaster recovery finance equitably.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Mandate that at least 55% of beneficiaries from CRF liquidity are women, enforce higher borrowing costs for non-compliant MFPs, and provide loan officer gender-bias training.",
      "evidence": "post-disaster assistance often fails to reach women equitably... target that at least 55% of the beneficiaries of MFPs benefitting from CRF liquidity are women"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Delays in negotiating, executing, and legally registering the Trust Deed between Ministry of Finance and SBP could delay project effectiveness and fund capitalization.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Ensure proactive legal coordination between the Ministry of Finance, State Bank of Pakistan, and World Bank legal teams to complete Trust Deed execution and registration.",
      "evidence": "The Trust Deed, in form and substance acceptable to the Association, has been executed... and registered in accordance with the legal requirements"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Failure or delay in securing national budget allocation for counterpart local currency requests could prevent disbursements under Category 2 of the credit line.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Incorporate required PKR budget allocations directly into the national fiscal budget planning process managed by the Ministry of Finance and SBP.",
      "evidence": "No withdrawals can take place under Category 2 until the Recipient has ensured... sufficient amount in its currency has been requested in its budget allocation"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Volatile pricing or limited availability in international reinsurance markets could make securing annual parametric insurance backstop coverage unviable for the CRF.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Conduct annual technical and financial reviews by the CRF Oversight Committee, leveraging GSFF grant funds and CRF investment income to support premium payments.",
      "evidence": "The final amounts are subject to an annual decision by the CRF Oversight Committee on insurance purchases, following technical and financial review"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Inaccurate risk modeling or inappropriate parametric trigger design could cause the CRF to fail to release post-disaster liquidity during localized flood shocks.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Establish dual independent trigger mechanisms verified by independent third-party risk modeling firms and detailed rigorously in the Project Operating Manual.",
      "evidence": "The definition of parametric indices, triggers, and a post event loss calculation (PELC) method, as part of the risk modelling, will be central"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Geographical clustering of agricultural and SME micro-loans could cause cumulative localized environmental degradation through increased chemical runoff and water contamination.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Apply SBP's Environmental and Social Management System screening processes and enforce negative lists and guidelines in accordance with the Environmental and Social Commitment Plan.",
      "evidence": "clustering of loans in geographical areas (such as in the cotton belt) where project interventions may increase use of fertilizers, pesticides and other chemicals."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Delays or operational difficulties in establishing effective partnerships between MFPs and Agriculture Technology Companies (ATCs) could impede deployment of the IAL product.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Execute the Agriculture Finance Innovation Challenge (AFIC) through SBP to pre-select a panel of qualified ATCs for seamless bundling with MFP loans.",
      "evidence": "MFPs that avail the IAL product will have to partner with at least one ATC selected under the AFIC."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Operational bottlenecks or administrative slow-downs within SBP governance structures could prevent post-flood liquidity deployment to MFPs within the target 60-day window.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Define streamlined operational TORs and delegation frameworks between the CRF Oversight Committee and Working Committee in the Project Operating Manual.",
      "evidence": "CRF liquidity which is deployed to originate loans within 60 days of qualifying floods (percentage)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Competing regulatory priorities or staffing constraints within SBP could create administrative bottlenecks in performing Trustee duties for the CRF Trust.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Utilize SBP's dedicated microfinance department and leverage existing operational expertise gained from implementing the Financial Inclusion and Infrastructure Project.",
      "evidence": "CRF will be established and capitalized as a Trust owned by the GoP and managed by the SBP as the Trustee"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Lack of coordination among international financial institutions (ADB, IFC, WB, FCDO, GIZ) could lead to overlapping de-risking structures and market fragmentation.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Align interventions under the shared 10-year microfinance sector vision and enforce clear market segmentation between ADB's WIF guarantee structure and WBG facilities.",
      "evidence": "clear market segmentation so that the proposed WBG guarantee structure compliments (rather than competes) with the ADB structure."
    }
  ]
}

risks.description: Recurring extreme flood events could overwhelm microfinance providers' capital buffers and lead to widespread borrower default across vulnerable agricultural and rural communities.
risks.mitigation: Establish and capitalize the Climate Risk Fund (CRF) to provide post-disaster contingent liquidity and transfer extreme risk through an international parametric reinsurance backstop.
risks.evidence: a 1-in-a-20-year flood, as an example, would impact 705,000 borrowers and US$189 million in lending.

risks.description: Macroeconomic instability and persistent inflation in Pakistan could impair borrower repayment capacity, degrading microfinance provider asset quality and curtailing overall lending.
risks.mitigation: Provide tailored liquidity facilities (IAL and CLF) on market-based terms while monitoring MFP capital adequacy and macroeconomic stress indicators.
risks.evidence: The impact of these shocks was exacerbated by the macroeconomic crisis brewing since late 2019.

risks.description: Climatic shocks can trigger a surge in non-performing loans (NPLs), leading to rapid capital adequacy erosion and liquidity impairment for Microfinance Banks (MFBs).
risks.mitigation: Deploy Contingent Liquidity Facility (CLF) funds after qualifying flood events to enable MFPs to restructure loans and issue fresh recovery loans.
risks.evidence: NPLs of MFBs in flood impacted areas surged by 25.7 percent... resulted in the rapid erosion of liquidity and capital of the MFBs.

risks.description: Structural disintermediation away from agricultural sector lending by MFPs increases financial exclusion for small farmers and pushes them toward exploitative informal debt sources.
risks.mitigation: Implement the Pre-Climate Event Innovative Agricultural Liquidity (IAL) product to bundle agricultural loans with precision advisory support from agritech companies.
risks.evidence: have led to a structural shift in the sector, which is gradually pivoting away from agriculture.

risks.description: Rapid expansion of short-term urban nano loans for consumption smoothing risks shifting microfinance away from productive investment and over-indebting vulnerable borrowers.
risks.mitigation: Incentivize MFPs through CRF liquidity allocations to expand productive lending in climate-smart agriculture and microenterprises.
risks.evidence: Nano loans have grown by 342 percent... alarming pivot away from lending for productive purposes to consumption smoothing.

risks.description: Structural gender disparities, loan officer biases, and post-disaster mobility constraints could prevent female borrowers from accessing emergency disaster recovery finance equitably.
risks.mitigation: Mandate that at least 55% of beneficiaries from CRF liquidity are women, enforce higher borrowing costs for non-compliant MFPs, and provide loan officer gender-bias training.
risks.evidence: post-disaster assistance often fails to reach women equitably... target that at least 55% of the beneficiaries of MFPs benefitting from CRF liquidity are women

risks.description: Delays in negotiating, executing, and legally registering the Trust Deed between Ministry of Finance and SBP could delay project effectiveness and fund capitalization.
risks.mitigation: Ensure proactive legal coordination between the Ministry of Finance, State Bank of Pakistan, and World Bank legal teams to complete Trust Deed execution and registration.
risks.evidence: The Trust Deed, in form and substance acceptable to the Association, has been executed... and registered in accordance with the legal requirements

risks.description: Failure or delay in securing national budget allocation for counterpart local currency requests could prevent disbursements under Category 2 of the credit line.
risks.mitigation: Incorporate required PKR budget allocations directly into the national fiscal budget planning process managed by the Ministry of Finance and SBP.
risks.evidence: No withdrawals can take place under Category 2 until the Recipient has ensured... sufficient amount in its currency has been requested in its budget allocation

risks.description: Volatile pricing or limited availability in international reinsurance markets could make securing annual parametric insurance backstop coverage unviable for the CRF.
risks.mitigation: Conduct annual technical and financial reviews by the CRF Oversight Committee, leveraging GSFF grant funds and CRF investment income to support premium payments.
risks.evidence: The final amounts are subject to an annual decision by the CRF Oversight Committee on insurance purchases, following technical and financial review

risks.description: Inaccurate risk modeling or inappropriate parametric trigger design could cause the CRF to fail to release post-disaster liquidity during localized flood shocks.
risks.mitigation: Establish dual independent trigger mechanisms verified by independent third-party risk modeling firms and detailed rigorously in the Project Operating Manual.
risks.evidence: The definition of parametric indices, triggers, and a post event loss calculation (PELC) method, as part of the risk modelling, will be central

risks.description: Geographical clustering of agricultural and SME micro-loans could cause cumulative localized environmental degradation through increased chemical runoff and water contamination.
risks.mitigation: Apply SBP's Environmental and Social Management System screening processes and enforce negative lists and guidelines in accordance with the Environmental and Social Commitment Plan.
risks.evidence: clustering of loans in geographical areas (such as in the cotton belt) where project interventions may increase use of fertilizers, pesticides and other chemicals.

risks.description: Delays or operational difficulties in establishing effective partnerships between MFPs and Agriculture Technology Companies (ATCs) could impede deployment of the IAL product.
risks.mitigation: Execute the Agriculture Finance Innovation Challenge (AFIC) through SBP to pre-select a panel of qualified ATCs for seamless bundling with MFP loans.
risks.evidence: MFPs that avail the IAL product will have to partner with at least one ATC selected under the AFIC.

risks.description: Operational bottlenecks or administrative slow-downs within SBP governance structures could prevent post-flood liquidity deployment to MFPs within the target 60-day window.
risks.mitigation: Define streamlined operational TORs and delegation frameworks between the CRF Oversight Committee and Working Committee in the Project Operating Manual.
risks.evidence: CRF liquidity which is deployed to originate loans within 60 days of qualifying floods (percentage)

risks.description: Competing regulatory priorities or staffing constraints within SBP could create administrative bottlenecks in performing Trustee duties for the CRF Trust.
risks.mitigation: Utilize SBP's dedicated microfinance department and leverage existing operational expertise gained from implementing the Financial Inclusion and Infrastructure Project.
risks.evidence: CRF will be established and capitalized as a Trust owned by the GoP and managed by the SBP as the Trustee

risks.description: Lack of coordination among international financial institutions (ADB, IFC, WB, FCDO, GIZ) could lead to overlapping de-risking structures and market fragmentation.
risks.mitigation: Align interventions under the shared 10-year microfinance sector vision and enforce clear market segmentation between ADB's WIF guarantee structure and WBG facilities.
risks.evidence: clear market segmentation so that the proposed WBG guarantee structure compliments (rather than competes) with the ADB structure.
